message.content:
An illustration depicts the torso and head of a smiling man with glasses, light brown skin, and dark hair. He wears a dark green collared shirt and a large ring on his right hand. His hands are positioned in front of his chest, using a pair of brown needles to knit with a white thread. The thread originates from the white garment of a small, standing man on his left shoulder. The small man wears a white robe draped over one shoulder and has his hands raised. Below the knitting needles, the man holds a large, partially visible currency note with green circular seals and a pattern of white and green lines.

Large, dark green block letters "TEMPO" span the top. Above them, text reads "REKAYASA HASIL AUDIT BPK / KEKERASAN SEKSUAL GURU JIS". Below the main title is the date "2-8 JUNI 2014". To the left of the man, large white text reads "ROBEK KOCEK TAMU TUHAN". Smaller yellow and white text below states: "Penyimpangan dana haji miliaran rupiah diduga melibatkan mantan Menteri Agama Suryadharma Ali. Tempo mendapat rinciannya." A barcode and "RP 35.000" appear in the bottom-left corner.
